$comment: DELIBERATELY EMPTY. The human fills this in.
Each entry sets a service's start type. The engine writes only the Start value under
HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\<name>, which takes effect at the next boot and
never stops a running service mid-session.
Start values: 2 = Automatic, 3 = Manual, 4 = Disabled. The engine refuses 0 and 1
(Boot and System drivers) outright - those are not tunable.
"start": 3, "whyEn": "one line the user reads before ticking it" }
Before adding one, verify the service name against Microsoft docs and add it to the
windows-verified-paths skill. ServiceWhitelist refuses anything matching the forbidden
list - Defender, firewall, network, audio, printer - whatever this file says.
